gloss: to devote oneself to; to concentrate on; to dedicate oneself to

definitions.gloss: to devote oneself to; to concentrate on; to dedicate oneself to
definitions.explanation: To focus all of one's effort and attention on a single task, activity, or goal, setting aside other concerns.

examples.japanese: ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{専念|せんねん}する。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{専念|せんねん}する⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: He took time off work to focus on his treatment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{専念|せんねん}する⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She quit her job to devote herself to raising her children.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{目|め}の{前|まえ}→目の前：22588_menomae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{専念|せんねん}しよう。
examples.english: Let's focus on what's in front of us right now.

notes:
The pattern is 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{専念|せんねん}する. Implies single-minded focus, often requiring the sacrifice or postponement of other activities. Common in news stories about celebrities or athletes stepping away from work.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{専念|せんねん}する: to devote oneself to work
- ⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{専念|せんねん}する: to focus on medical treatment
- ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{専念|せんねん}する: to concentrate on studying
- ⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{専念|せんねん}する: to dedicate oneself to childcare
- ⟦{本業|ほんぎょう}→本業：12887_hongyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{専念|せんねん}する: to focus on one's core business

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}する→集中する：21908_shuuchuusuru⟧: to concentrate — focuses on mental focus rather than dedicating one's life to something
- ⟦{没頭|ぼっとう}する→没頭する：18376_bottousuru⟧: to be absorbed in — implies being so engrossed that one loses track of surroundings
- ⟦{打|う}ち{込|こ}む→打ち込む：04229_uchikomu⟧: to throw oneself into — more casual; emphasizes passionate engagement
